title: DETECTION RATE AND CLASSIFICATION OF BREAST LESIONS WITH DIGITAL MAMMOGRAPHY WITH CONTRAST MEDIUM (CEDM) ALONE AND IN COMBINATION WITH TOMOSYNTHESIS COMPARED TO MR IMAGING WITH GADOLINIUM IN DYNAMICS (DCE-MRI) - CEDM-MRI
official: DETECTION RATE AND CLASSIFICATION OF BREAST LESIONS WITH DIGITAL MAMMOGRAPHY WITH CONTRAST MEDIUM (CEDM) ALONE AND IN COMBINATION WITH TOMOSYNTHESIS COMPARED TO MR IMAGING WITH GADOLINIUM IN DYNAMICS (DCE-MRI) - CEDM-MRI
summary: Main objective: Evaluate, on a large case series, the detection rate and diagnostic accuracy, as well as the extent of breast pathology in terms of multifocality, multicentricity, and bilaterality, of CEDM alone and in combination with tomosynthesis, compared to MRI, considered both as CE-MRI and DCE-MRI.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age > 18 years
2. Patients with suspected breast pathology or patients in pre-surgical staging for breast pathology already confirmed by conventional imaging (Ultrasound and/or traditional 2D Mammography) or by cytological/histopathological examination
3. Full information about the study and signing of the informed consent to participate in the study
4. Performance of exams at any time during the menstrual cycle
5. Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) > 60 mL/min/1.73 m², derived from serum creatinine measurement within two weeks prior to enrollment in the study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Presence of pacemakers or other devices in the chest wall
2. Allergies to iodinated contrast media and/or gadolinium
3. Claustrophobia
4. Acute renal failure of any severity due to hepatorenal syndrome and/or established in the preoperative period of liver transplantation
5. Acute or chronic renal failure, moderate or severe (glomerular filtration rate <60 mL/min/1.73m²)
6. Hypersensitivity to the active ingredient of the contrast medium or any of its excipients
7. Overt thyrotoxicosis
8. Participation in a clinical trial where an investigational drug was administered within 30 days or 5 half-lives of the study drug
9. Any clinical condition that, in the investigator's opinion, would render the patient unsuitable for the study
10. Presence of breast implants
11. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
12. Inability to remain still during the examination
13. Presence of severe heart disease and pulmonary hypertension
14. Presence of acute brain disorders, history of epilepsy
15. Presence of paraproteinemia (myelomatosis and Waldenström's macroglobulinemia)
16. Presence of pheochromocytoma
17. Presence of hyperthyroidism
18. Inflammatory dermatological diseases (psoriasis, eczema, etc.)
19. Presence of tattoos in the affected area
20. Presence of nipple piercings that cannot be removed
21. Internal/external devices that prevent proper patient positioning
22. Metallic/electronic implants, metal fragments
23. Specific breast morphology that hinders the examination (particularly overly large breasts)
24. Allergies to metals
